C1.worst_defect: The hero is clear ('Point of sale for Vendure', with Vendure explained in one clause), but the first thing above the h1 is the badge 'Pre-release · plugin 0.3.0', and the first proof cards go straight to developer language ('the Vendure plugin saves that id with the order in one step', 'Read the 200-send test'). A newcomer who half knows Vendure gets the what, but not who it is for (does a small shop owner do this, or their developer?).
C1.where: home/desktop/01 (badge above h1, 'Every sale lands once' card); home/phone/01-02

C2.worst_defect: The comparison table's demo cell says 'All it sends is anonymous usage events to ph.wcpos.com'. That is an unexplained third-party domain, and nothing on the home page says who makes VendurePOS (the footer only has 'Built with TallyUI. For Medusa, see MedusaPOS.'). An honest disclosure therefore leaves a first-timer asking 'who is wcpos, and who is behind this?'
C2.where: home/desktop/02 'Live demo or your own store' table, last row; home footer

C3.worst_defect: The quick start is complete, down to 'Check it worked', but it carries a collapsed leftover, 'If your store already allows vendurepos.vercel.app', in step 5. To a newcomer that reads as an old domain nobody cleaned up, inside the most important how-to.

C4.worst_defect: The Changelog is written for the maintainers, not readers: '(ADR 0005)', '(#116)', 'order.create v5 custom lines are real order lines on a plugin-owned, disabled ...'. It also has the aside 'Not in the release notes: in 0.2.0 and 0.3.0 this role has no ReadOrder'. A visitor checking how active and mature the project is gets internal references instead of a plain summary.

C5.worst_defect: Below the hero screenshot, the home page becomes a page of grey text at one weight. There are eight icon-less feature blocks, a 7-row Yes/No table, then a 7-bullet 'Before you start' list with 'Node ^20.19 || >=22.12' and 'RXDB_PREMIUM'. It ends in inline links rather than a button, so it reads like a docs page, not a landing page.
C5.where: home/desktop/01 bottom to home/desktop/02; same in home.desktop-dark

C6.worst_defect: Minor: the phone hero image is cropped to the till's search bar, filter chips and two product tiles, so the 'sale in progress' from the caption is only a 'Cart (3) · €20.09' tab label. Otherwise there is no overflow, the table turns into stacked cards, and code wraps readably.

C7.worst_defect: Small: every sitemap.xml <lastmod> is stamped 18–19 Nov 2026 (build time, not content change), and Lighthouse flags 53 KiB unused JS with quick-start LCP at 2.6 s. Titles, descriptions, the OG card, JSON-LD, llms.txt, search API and the 404 (real 404 status) are all good.

overall_worst.defect: A first-time visitor who scrolls past the hero to decide whether to try it ends on server prerequisites ('Node ^20.19 || >=22.12', 'Postgres', 'RxDB Premium licence token (RXDB_PREMIUM)') and a paragraph of inline links. There is no closing Live demo button. The low-commitment next step that suits this visitor is only at the very top of a long, text-only page.
overall_worst.where: home/desktop/02 'Before you start' to footer; home/phone/04-05
overall_worst.fix: End the home page with a short closing band ('Try it in your browser', with Live demo and Quick start buttons), placed after or instead of the inline-link paragraph. Move the server prerequisites behind a 'For developers' heading or link them to the Overview's Requirements.
